items.title: 歐盟調查Booking.com，關注住宿業者帳號遭接管及訂房詐騙
items.summary: 10月21日歐盟執委會宣布，依據《數位服務法》（Digital Services Act，DSA）對總部位於荷蘭的線上訂房平臺Booking.com展開正式調查，將檢視該平臺是否採取充分措施，防止詐騙者刊登虛假住宿資訊，或利用平臺進行網路釣魚及訂房詐騙。

items.title: 美國資安職缺年減26%，AI安全工程師逆勢成長
items.summary: 美國資安人才招聘業者CyberSN近期分析美國資安職缺刊登情況，發現2026年1月至9月，美國資安職缺刊登量為235,786筆，較2025年同期減少26.4%，創2023年以來同期新低。不過，各類資安職務的職缺變化並不一致，其中資安長（CISO）相關職缺年減38.9%，AI安全工程師（AI Security Engineer）職缺則逆勢年增268.3%。

items.title: Chrome預設啟用HTTP連線前警告，降低資料暴露風險
items.summary: Google於10月21日宣布Chrome瀏覽器已預設啟用HTTP連線前警告機制，使用者造訪一般HTTP網站時，Chrome會先要求使用者確認是否繼續存取，再建立HTTP連線。過去Chrome主要在建立連線後，才於網址列顯示Not Secure（不安全）標示，使用者可能已經暴露於資料遭攔截或竄改的風險。新機制則將警告提前至連線建立前，讓使用者先了解風險，再決定是否繼續存取網站。

items.title: OpenSSF發布AI漏洞處理指引，強調漏洞驗證與人工審查
items.summary: AI已能協助開發人員尋找軟體漏洞，攻擊者也開始利用AI發動攻擊，軟體開發團隊因此更需要及早修補漏洞，避免遭攻擊者利用。開源軟體安全基金會（OpenSSF）發布AI漏洞發現與修補指引，由旗下Best Practices及AI/ML工作小組共同制定，提供開發人員利用AI尋找及修補自家軟體漏洞的實務建議，也供協助開發團隊尋找漏洞的資安研究人員參考。

items.title: fix(control-ui): keep sidebar rows steady through reload (#180569)
items.summary: fix(control-ui): keep sidebar rows steady through reload (#180569) Peter reported a late sidebar flicker on Team reloads. The live r183 filmstrip showed one shrink-then-grow at the cached-to-live handoff: the snapshot owner released cached rows as soon as the root sessions list answered, while visible child-session queries (expanded rows) were still loading, so the sidebar briefly dropped from 24 to 20 rows and grew back. The handoff now waits until the live roster is complete for the current scope: the canonical sessions.list has published (not a reconnect revision), and every visible child parent has loaded or errored. The cached rows stay exactly as they are until then, with a 3 s cap from connect (at the cap, whatever has arrived is shown). Snapshot rows now record childLoadParentKeys so the restored tree knows which parents' children it shows; old cache records without it, or any record that fails validation, are deleted and rebuilt instead of failing the whole read (disposable cache, no migration). Evidence (AWS c7a.4xlarge, staggered-query Team-scale fixture, 11 interleaved pairs per route on the rebased head): chat and dashboard both 2 -> 1 transitions, 0 shrink-grow, 0 blank frames, all 24 row nodes retained; chat LoAF -6 ms, hello -15 ms, settled -3.9 ms, FCP 0 ms (paired). Accepted tradeoff (maintainer): dashboard-reload LoAF +24 ms paired median (IQR -9..+45) vs an A/A noise band of -27 (IQR -47..+21). Runtime +42 LOC. Touched-area e2e 9 files / 25 tests passed; changed checks 27 passed, 3 failures inherited from main; exact-head CI green.

items.title: fix(ci): local checks fail on clean main while CI stays green (#179181)
items.summary: fix(ci): local checks fail on clean main while CI stays green (#179181) * fix(ci): block baseline inventory drift in CI and keep shard size advisory The max-lines suppression inventory and the OPENCLAW_* budget used the limit severity policy, so GitHub Actions only annotated a tree that disagreed with its own inventory. Main absorbed moved suppressions, stale entries, and unrecorded env names with green CI, and every later local ratchet run failed on debt the branch did not create. Inventory/tree consistency (unlisted suppression, stale entry, name count different from the budget) now blocks everywhere, like the sibling shrink ratchets. Growth relative to the merge base keeps the limit policy so owner-approved growth still lands with a CI warning. The core tsgo shard root budget is a shared cost signal its contract marks advisory; routing it through the limit reporter made it locally fatal. It now warns everywhere. Proof: new ratchet and env-budget regressions fail on the base scripts and pass with the fix; the real boundary check on main's shard layout exits 0 with four advisory warnings instead of failing. * ci(tsgo): rebalance core test shards under the root budget agents-tools (722), gateway-root (725), infra (728), and plugins-platform (728) exceeded the advisory 720-root limit. Move whole test globs to shards with headroom: src/media to messaging, src/acp to gateway-other, src/security to config-cli, and root src/gateway/github* to gateway-methods. The largest shard is now 719 roots and exactly-once ownership holds. Messaging test-root selection of the shard guard now includes src/media. * ci(tsgo): move agents CLI backend tests into the commands shard Newer main tests pushed agents-root to 722 roots. Root-level src/agents/cli-*.test.ts files join the commands shard, which already owns src/agents/command and CLI program tests: agents-root 693, commands 516. * test(ui): split chat message rendering coverage Preserve current main coverage across grouping, markdown, tools, attachments, and images, sharing render lifecycle and attachment fixtures. Keep all 59 direct cases and eight parameterized declarations, expanding to the same 79 passing tests. The image disclosure case now waits for its lazy renderer instead of depending on an earlier image test. All seven files have line-cap headroom; UI types and scoped lint pass. Independent review found no actionable P0-P2 defects. * chore(ci): reconcile max-lines baseline and env budget with main Prune 70 stale max-lines entries (508 -> 438). Reconcile the counted OPENCLAW_* budget from 452 -> 461 and rename the internal agent FTS schema constant. Record FACTORY_GITHUB_PROOF, FACTORY_ACTOR_ID, FACTORY_SESSION_KEY (#173668), IMAGE_ACTIVATION_CAPTURE_MARKER (#173711), UPDATE_DOCTOR_HISTORICAL_SCANS (#177933), SESSION_WATCHDOG (#176915), PACKAGE_PERMISSIONS_REPAIRED (#175423), PLUGIN_NPM_ROOTS_FALLBACK (#176121), DISABLE_CRON_HOST_EXECUTION and DISABLE_GATEWAY_LOCAL_TERMINALS (#177855), and the removal of DEVICE_NAME_PREFIX (#178345). All names above use the OPENCLAW_ prefix. AGENT_FTS_SCHEMAS is an internal constant, not an environment variable.
